data.current_summary: Submit a new job for AI Analysis
data.current_description:
Introduction and Definitions

This endpoint allows you to submit jobs to 2MW for AI analysis.

Each job contains one or more cutups.

A cutup is a group of individual plays. It can have a single play, or multiple plays that are from the same game or from different games.

A play is a video clip that shows a single football play, beginning at the pre-motion formation up to the end of play. We currently require a sideline view of the video but we are currently working for support on endzone views.

The video clip of the play can come from a pre-cut video file, or it can come from a monolithic video file containing multiple plays stitched together. The request body described below allows for both sources.

Required Data

To submit a job for AI analysis, there are a couple of things you need to prepare:

  • URL Links to Video Files

    The video can be a short clips of individual plays, or a monolithic video file that contains a different plays stitched together from either the same game or different games. Simply provide the URL Links to these video clips.

  • Start Frames and Duration of Each Play

    If the video contains more than one play, you will need to specify the start frames and duration frames of each play.

    Note: the endpoint expects the exact frame count and not timestamps.

  • Team and Game Info (optional)

    For better results, you can optionally provide:

    • Offense Team
    • Defense Team
    • Year and Week of the Game

Required inputs: video file URLs (individual play clips or monolithic files with multiple plays) and frame-level metadata (start frame and duration for each play in frame counts, not timestamps). Optional inputs: offense team, defense team, game year, and week for improved analysis accuracy. Returns a jobID for tracking the submission status. Supports both pre-cut video clips and stitched monolithic video files from single or multiple games.

data.current_summary: Submit a new job for AI Analysis
data.current_description:
Introduction and Definitions

This endpoint allows you to submit jobs to 2MW for AI analysis.

Each job contains one or more cutups.

A cutup is a group of individual plays. It can have a single play, or multiple plays that are from the same game or from different games.

A play is a video clip that shows a single football play, beginning at the pre-motion formation up to the end of play. We currently require a sideline view of the video but we are currently working for support on endzone views.

The video clip of the play can come from a pre-cut video file, or it can come from a monolithic video file containing multiple plays stitched together. The request body described below allows for both sources.

Required Data

To submit a job for AI analysis, there are a couple of things you need to prepare:

  • URL Links to Video Files

    The video can be a short clips of individual plays, or a monolithic video file that contains a different plays stitched together from either the same game or different games. Simply provide the URL Links to these video clips.

  • Start Frames and Duration of Each Play

    If the video contains more than one play, you will need to specify the start frames and duration frames of each play.

    Note: the endpoint expects the exact frame count and not timestamps.

  • Team and Game Info (optional)

    For better results, you can optionally provide:

    • Offense Team
    • Defense Team
    • Year and Week of the Game
